# quay_repository (Data Source)

Fetches information about a Quay repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "quay_repository" "example" {
  namespace = "my-org"
  name      = "my-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the repository.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace (organization or username) that owns the repository.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The markdown description of the repository.
- `id` (String) The resource identifier (namespace/name).
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the repository: public or private.
